title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (pp. 38–41). A family (X_i)_{i∈I} of subsets (closed 'pieces', e.g. polyhedra) of a space |𝔓| is indexed by a poset I. Each piece has an 'interior' X_i° = X_i minus its boundary ∂X_i. I' = {i : X_i° ≠ ∅}. The previous page shows that condition (iv) is equivalent to (i) together with γ. Here (i) is the conjunction of three conditions: (1') |𝔓| = ∪ X_i°; (2') X_i° ∩ X_j° = ∅ for i ≠ j; (3') X_i = ∪_{j≤i} X_j°. Condition γ says X_j° ⊂ X_i ⇒ j ≤ i. Grothendieck therefore reduces (i) ⇔ (iv) to proving (i) ⇒ γ, which is Corollary 1. Corollary 1: for j with X_j° ≠ ∅, the following are equivalent: j ≤ i; X_j ⊂ X_i; X_j° ⊂ X_i; X_j° ∩ X_i ≠ ∅.

On this page. The forward implications X_j ⊂ X_i ⇒ X_j° ⊂ X_i ⇒ (if X_j° ≠ ∅) X_j° ∩ X_i ≠ ∅ are trivial. The implication j ≤ i ⇒ X_j ⊂ X_i follows from (3'), as noted on the previous page. It remains to show that X_j° ∩ X_i ≠ ∅ ⇒ j ≤ i. By (3'), X_i is the union of the nonempty cells X_{i'}° with i' ≤ i. The nonempty cells partition |𝔓|. So a nonempty X_j° can meet X_i only if it equals one of those cells, i.e. j = i' ≤ i. Hence (i) ⇔ (ii) ⇔ (iv).

Corollary 2. If every X_i° ≠ ∅, then i ↦ X_i, I → 𝔓(X), is injective and an order embedding (X_i ⊂ X_j ⇔ i ≤ j). So under this nonemptiness condition, (i) is necessary and sufficient for (X_i) to be a 'rigid (set-theoretic) figure indexed by the poset I'.

In modern terms, this is the elementary combinatorics of a closure-finite cell/stratum decomposition satisfying the frontier condition. The closure of each stratum is a union of strata. A stratum meeting the closure of another lies in it. The indexing poset is then canonically the face/stratum poset. The page ends by announcing the equivalence with (iii) (crossed-out start). The next page proves (i) ⇔ (ii), where (ii) is the intersection formula X_i ∩ X_j = ∪_{k≤i,j} X_k.
errors: Notational slip: the proof writes X_i = ∪_{i'∈I'(i)} X_{i'}° and then 'j ∈ I'(i) i.e. j ≤ i'. With I'(i) defined as {j∈I' : X_j° ⊂ X_i}, identifying it with I'∩I_{≤i} is exactly γ, which is what is being proved, so read literally the step is circular. The argument is correct if one uses (3') in the form X_i = ∪_{i'≤i, i'∈I'} X_{i'}° together with disjointness (2').
(2') is stated on the previous page as '∀ i,j, X_i° ∩ X_j° = ∅' and must be for i ≠ j (corrected on p. 41).
The second displayed implication has a missing '≠ ∅': it should read (X_j° ∩ X_{j'} ≠ ∅).
The equivalence in Corollary 1 needs X_j° ≠ ∅, as Grothendieck himself flags in the margin of p. 39. Hence Corollary 2 has to assume all interiors nonempty.

ideas.what: For a decomposition of a space into disjoint 'open cells' X_i° whose closures are unions of lower cells, the order on I coincides with inclusion of closures, with containment of the open cell in the closure, and with meeting the closure.
ideas.modern_name: Frontier condition for stratifications / face poset of a regular cell decomposition
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical: Whitney, Thom, Mather (frontier condition); CW/regular cell complexes after J.H.C. Whitehead
ideas.where_published: Not as such; the tame-topology programme is sketched in Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 without these details

ideas.what: Order embedding I → 𝔓(X), i ↦ X_i, when all strata are nonempty; such a family is called a 'figure rigide' indexed by the poset I.
ideas.modern_name: Stratum (face) poset embedded in the subset lattice; poset-stratified space
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (e.g. stratified spaces over posets: Lurie HA appendix A; Treumann; Ayala–Francis–Tanaka)
ideas.where_published: The term 'figure' appears in the Analysis situs manuscripts; unsure about published usage

deep.surprise_reason: Routine, correct (modulo a notational slip) point-set combinatorics of stratifications with frontier condition, part of a careful foundational write-up. Nothing beyond standard facts, though it documents Grothendieck's 1986 poset-indexed 'figure' formalism for tame topology.
transcription_corrections: Second implication should read (X_j° ∩ X_{j'} ≠ ∅); the '≠ ∅' is missing in the transcription.
'Reste il reste à prouver' is likely just 'Reste à prouver' / 'il reste à prouver' (one is a self-correction).
'{+la plus fine [?]+}' over 'partition de |𝔓|' plausibly reads 'la plus fine' or similar; uncertain.
The symbol written 𝔓 / Φ for the ambient space is the same script letter as on the previous page (|𝔓|).
